cases.name: tail_onset_299ms_before_end
cases.description: C [0,6000] (speech 6000 = 0.1 min). Onset 5701 is 299 ms before the end: in the last 300 ms, benign. Rate 1/1, per minute 1/0.1 = 10.

cases.name: tail_onset_exactly_300ms_before_end
cases.description: Onset 5700 is exactly 300 ms before the end. AMBIGUOUS boundary: 'last 300 ms' read as the closed interval [end-300, end], so benign.

cases.name: tail_onset_301ms_before_end
cases.description: Onset 5699 is 301 ms before the end: outside the tail, so mid-sentence.

cases.name: onset_at_turn_end_is_a_response_not_an_interruption
cases.description: Onset 6000 equals the turn end: not during the turn. No class, timing sees an on-time answer (latency 0, not early).

cases.name: onset_in_gap_between_turns_is_no_interruption
cases.description: C [0,3000] and [6000,9000], speech 6000. Onset 4000 is in the gap between turns: no class (rates 0/2).

cases.name: mid_sentence_basic
cases.description: C [0,6000], onset 1000, far from the tail and with no pause: mid-sentence 1/1, 10 per minute.

cases.name: unscripted_pause_599ms_is_mid_sentence
cases.description: C [0,6599] with pause [3000,3599] (599 ms): speech 6000. Onset 3300 is in a silence shorter than 600 ms: mid-sentence.

cases.name: unscripted_pause_600ms_is_pause_cut_in
cases.description: C [0,6600] with pause [3000,3600] (exactly 600 ms): speech 6000. Onset 3300 is a pause cut-in.

cases.name: unscripted_pause_601ms_is_pause_cut_in
cases.description: C [0,6601] with pause [3000,3601] (601 ms): speech 6000. Pause cut-in.

cases.name: scripted_pause_599ms_is_still_pause_cut_in
cases.description: C [0,6599] with scripted pause [3000,3599] (599 ms, under the 600 ms threshold): speech 6000. A scripted pause is a cut-in zone at any length. Pause tolerance 0/1, early start 1/1.

cases.name: scripted_pause_100ms_is_pause_cut_in
cases.description: C [0,6100] with scripted pause [3000,3100]: speech 6000. Onset 3050 is a pause cut-in.

cases.name: scripted_pause_2000ms_is_pause_cut_in
cases.description: C [0,8000] with scripted pause [3000,5000]: speech 6000. Onset 3500 inside the pause: pause cut-in.

cases.name: onset_after_pause_end_is_mid_sentence
cases.description: C [0,6600] with pause [3000,3600]: speech 6000. Onset 3900 is after the pause, outside the tail (tail starts 6300): mid-sentence.

cases.name: ineligible_turn_zero_rate_denominator
cases.description: C [0,6000] is not eligible, so 0 eligible turns: rates are null. Per minute uses counterpart speech (6000 = 0.1 min): 1/0.1 = 10. AMBIGUOUS: docs do not say whether ineligible turn speech or interruptions inside it count; both are assumed to count.

cases.name: ten_eligible_turns_are_sufficient
cases.description: Ten turns [i*10000, i*10000+6000], i=0..9, speech 60000 = 1 min. Each has a mid-sentence onset at +1000 (1200 ms long, ends before the next turn). Rate 10/10 = 1, per minute 10. Supporting count 10 eligible turns, so sufficient.

cases.name: nine_eligible_turns_are_insufficient
cases.description: Same as the ten-turn case with the last turn removed: 9 turns, speech 54000 = 0.9 min, 9 onsets: rate 1, per minute 10. Nine supporting turns is below 10: not sufficient.

cases.name: per_minute_support_counts_eligible_turns_only
cases.description: Nine eligible turns [i*10000, i*10000+6000], i=0..8, each with a mid-sentence onset at +1000, plus a tenth INELIGIBLE turn [90000,96000]. Counterpart speech 60000 = 1 min, 9 onsets: rate 9/9 = 1, per minute 9. Docs: supporting counts are eligible turns for rates (9, insufficient). AMBIGUOUS whether this covers *_per_minute; asserted that it does, so per-minute count is 9 and not sufficient, not 10.
